source.note: A real Solana pool (JEANPHIL/SOL on PumpSwap), replayed as a rehearsal. It is not HUNCH, and HUNCH is not live.
source.candles: 7509 five-minute OHLCV candles of the pool (7 missing), merged to 10-minute bars: last close of the bar, summed volume
source.rounding: close and vol to 6 significant figures

reserve.method: SOL reserve estimated as sqrt(k x price) on a constant-product curve; k runs from the opening (206.9M tokens, the pump.fun graduation deposit, at the first price) to a DexScreener reading of the pool at the end of the window, interpolated in log by cumulative volume (fees and liquidity adds grow k). Used only for the 1% buy cap
